When neither eventId nor a date range is supplied, the summary falls back to the default last_30_days range (legacy semantics).

dateTo.description: Date-range scope end (ISO 8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD). Inclusive calendar day; both dates required whenever a date range is given; span must cover at most 30 inclusive calendar days. When neither eventId nor a date range is supplied, the summary falls back to the default last_30_days range (legacy semantics).
